履修条件
Graduate students who have an undergraduate-level background in science and engineering.
The students need to go to Busan, Korea in August 2026 to take this course.
授業概要
このコースを受講することにより、企業見学やフィールドトリップへの参加、エネルギーおよび環境科学技術分野の実験スキルを学ぶことができます。
このコースは英語のみで行われます。
In this course, graduate students may participate in industry tours and feild trips, as well as learn experimental skills in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology.
This course will be given by English only.

全体の教育目標
The overall aim of this course is for students to learn about topical issues, current state of the industry, as well as experimental skills in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology.
個別の教育目標
This course is specifically aimed at helping students to broaden their horizons and improve their experimental skills in the fields of energy and environmental science and engineering in an informative, engaging, and professional manner.
授業計画
This course will be given in the Summer School of CAMPUS Asia plus program (CA+), which will be held in the latter half of August 2026, in Pusan National University, Korea
The course may consist of feild trips and industry tours, as well as lab works and group discussions in the fields of energy, environment, and material science and engineering.
At the end of this course, the students will be divided into several groups to present their studies to all professors come from CA+ partner universities.
The course details will be announced before the middle of August 2026.
This course will be given by English only.
